summary: Frontend-only regression testing for AvrupaPazari fixes: map link module context, AJAX-only listing updates (no reload), .sh-cats-slider hidden, and Switzerland (CH) country. All 5 test areas passed.

tests_executed.name: Map header link module context
tests_executed.details: nav-map href: / => /pages/map.php; search-vehicles => ?module=arac; property => ?module=emlak; second-hand => ?module=ikinci_el; businesses => ?module=esnaf. In-page .sh-hero-categories Haritada Ara link on vehicles=?module=arac and property=?module=emlak (previously wrongly ikinci_el, now fixed). /pages/map.php?module=arac returns 200.

tests_executed.name: AJAX filter/sort no-reload
tests_executed.details: On search-vehicles/property/second-hand: set window.__marker=1 & sidebar __flag='kept', changed sort select in .sh-main. URL changed via pushState, marker preserved (=1) and sidebar DOM node identity preserved (__flag='kept'). No full page reload.

tests_executed.name: .sh-cats-slider hidden + no errors
tests_executed.details: On all 4 listing pages (search-vehicles, property, second-hand, businesses): computed display of .sh-cats-slider = 'none'; .sh-sidebar visible; 0 console errors; no PHP warnings/notices/fatal errors in HTML.

tests_executed.name: Switzerland (CH) added
tests_executed.details: #ivCountrySelect first 9 real options order: Hollanda, Almanya, Belçika, Fransa, Avusturya, İsviçre, Danimarka, Türkiye, Polonya - matches expected. CH option present with text 'İsviçre'. Sidebar select[name=country_id] on search-vehicles also has 'İsviçre' option (value=13).

tests_executed.name: Regression: /account.php redirect + login + jobs.php
tests_executed.details: /account.php while logged out redirects to /?auth=login. Login via modal (data-testid login-email/login-password/login-submit) with test@avrupapazari.com / Test12345! redirects to /account.php showing 'Test User'. /pages/jobs.php loads.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 2 verified this round's 4 fixes + regression smoke. Note: login modal has TWO forms in DOM (register + login), so use data-testid='login-email' / 'login-password' / 'login-submit' for the login form (plain input[type=email] first-match hits the hidden register form). Sidebar country_id uses numeric IDs (İsviçre=13), while ivCountrySelect uses ISO codes (CH). AJAX flow proven via preserved window.__marker + sidebar DOM property; do not rely on URL equality alone.
